text_block_list.text:
Growing up in a family that ran a 
hospital, Aston Machan was always close to 
life and death. Perhaps because of that, 
she fears one day disappearing and being 
forgotten.

How can I make sure people remember 
forever? One answer was to have an 
official URA mascot made and spread it 
across the entire world!

However, in her generation were formidable 
rivals: Daiwa Scarlet, an honor student in 
both racing and academics; and Vodka, who 
pursued sheer coolness.

Meanwhile, aiming to leave a lasting mark 
on both hearts and history, she sets her 
sights on conquering the Triple Tiara 
route: the Oka Sho, the Yushun Himba 
(Oaks), and the Shuka Sho.

And so began the days of battling to 
become the Ultra Super Mascot...!
